simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to יַבֵּל (H2990) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: יַבֵּל (yabbêl) means having running sores First listed occurrence: Lev 22 22.

definitions.full: H2990. yabbal [ יַבָּל ] adjective running, suppurating — only feminine singular as substantive, יַבֶּלֶת a running sore or ulcer Lev 22:22 (+ יַלֶּפֶת גָּרָב, חָרוּץ, שָׁבוּר, עַוֶּרֶת, ).
